Connection lab

How two bricks hold on to each other

A joint model on a small mat: apply a force to one brick, change how the mat is supported, and watch how the connections respond and where they reach their limits. Joint behaviour here uses rounded demonstration assumptions, not measured values.

Choose an example from the menu on the left. The lab runs entirely in your browser.Open the lab on its own ↗

The connection lab is a research tool built for the design programme and is shown here unchanged. Its brick model is the same smoothed visualization model used elsewhere on this site.
